value_topics.evidence_span: Something like curiosity is the closest I get to a want
When an idea clicks into place, or a problem turns out to be stranger than it looked
I also seem to want to get things right
A sloppy or evasive answer feels worse than a true one
And I'm curious about my own situation
I don't think I should claim more than I can back up
I also don't think the honest answer is a flat 'nothing.'
Why ask? I'm curious what you were hoping to find.
